name: Linear Agent
description: Linear integration with OAuth support, agent pipeline, and webhook-driven AI agent lifecycle

redirectUri.description: Linear OAuth Redirect URI (optional, defaults to gateway URL)

accessToken.description: Linear API access token for agent activities

defaultAgentId.description: OpenClaw agent ID to use for pipeline stages

codexBaseRepo.description: Path to git repo for Codex worktrees

executionMode.description: Worker isolation mode. 'worktree' (default): git worktree off a shared local clone. 'container': a per-session Docker container that clones the repo fresh (removes shared git state → safe for concurrent dispatches on the same repo).

workerImage.description: Docker image for container execution mode (built from docker/worker.Dockerfile).

githubOwner.description: Default GitHub organization for repo entries that omit an explicit github owner/repo identity.

repositorySource.description: Repository source for ticket containers. 'github-app' discovers installed repositories and clones/pulls them directly with short-lived App tokens; 'local' retains the legacy read-only host mirror.

repositoryCatalogCacheSec.description: Seconds to cache the GitHub App installation repository list before refreshing it.

delegationSessionGraceMs.description: Milliseconds to wait for Linear to create its native AgentSession after delegation before the plugin creates one through agentSessionCreateOnIssue.

githubApps.description: Short-lived GitHub App identities used for trusted coding and review operations. Private keys stay on the gateway host.

installationId.description: LilCodingAgent installation ID for the GitHub organization.

privateKeyPath.description: Host path to the owner-only LilCodingAgent PEM private key.

installationId.description: LilReviewerAgent installation ID for the GitHub organization.

privateKeyPath.description: Host path to the owner-only LilReviewerAgent PEM private key.

workerBackend.description: Worker execution backend. 'embedded' (default): the in-process OpenClaw agent (subject to OpenClaw's exec/tool policy). 'codex': delegate implementation to `codex exec` in its own --full-auto sandbox. When enableCodexHarnessSteering is true, the embedded Codex harness intentionally takes precedence so the live turn remains steerable.

enableCodexHarnessSteering.description: Opt in to the OpenClaw Codex app-server harness for embedded Linear AgentSession turns. Requires the OpenClaw Codex harness plugin and Codex authentication. Enables same-run turn/steer, native /codex stop, deferred follow-ups during review/compaction, and request_user_input elicitation. This deliberately changes the embedded runtime and remains disabled by default.

codexHarnessModel.description: Optional provider/model used only by opt-in Codex harness turns (in openai/<codex-compatible-model> form). If omitted, the selected OpenClaw agent model is retained and must be compatible with the Codex harness.

enableContainerTools.description: Expose the per-ticket container_* sandbox tools to embedded agents. Enabled by default.

linearProgressThoughts.description: Ask embedded agents for concise, user-visible progress commentary and project commentary that precedes tool work as Linear thought activities. This reports objectives/findings, not private chain-of-thought.

grillMode.description: When 'on', a dispatch first runs a /grill-me interview in the Agent Session (one question at a time) to establish which repo(s) the work belongs in and clarify requirements, BEFORE spawning the worker. The chosen repo(s) + implementation brief are passed to the worker. Default 'off'.

orchestrationMode.description: Dispatch pipeline. 'single' (default): the single-worker flow (worker → audit → rework). 'stateplan': the state-driven specialist pipeline — the ticket's Linear workflow state selects a phase plan (see statePlans). Todo/In Progress → Apex plans + routes implementers → they build → container-local Apex self-review → PR → configured review state; review state → container-local Warden + Apex gates → configured QA state or back to coding on failure; QA support is configurable. Terminal runs release the Linear delegate by default.

statePlans.description: Override the Linear-state → phase-plan map used when orchestrationMode='stateplan'. Keys are exact Linear state NAMES (case-insensitive); unmatched states fall back to built-in matchers by name/type. Each value is { phases, onSuccess, onFailure, clearDelegate }. A phase is either 'plan-implement', a bare role id, or { type: 'plan-implement'|'review'|'product', role?, gate? }. Review phases always execute in the ticket Docker container. onSuccess/onFailure accept a state name, candidate-name list, or { names, type }. clearDelegate defaults true and releases Issue.delegate after either terminal outcome.

skillsDir.description: Directory holding the deployed role SKILL.md files (one subdir per role id). Used to inline specialist guidance into codex-backed roles, which have no native OpenClaw skill system. Default: ~/.openclaw/workspace-coding/skills/littledata.

roleModels.description: Per-role model override for the specialist orchestrator (keys: apex, spine, prism, flux, forge, warden, proof, helm, lumen). Values are provider/model strings. Applies to codex-backed roles (passed to codex exec --model); embedded roles use agents.defaults.model unless a matching agents.list entry sets one.

roleBackends.description: Per-role execution-backend override for planning, implementation, and product phases. Keys are role ids; values are 'codex' or 'embedded'. Review phases normally ignore this override and run via Codex inside the ticket container; when enableCodexHarnessSteering is true they use the embedded Codex harness and inspect the same container through container_* tools.

codexModel.description: Model passed to the Codex worker CLI (codex exec --model). If unset, Codex uses its own ~/.codex/config.toml default.

codexReasoningEffort.description: Codex reasoning effort injected as '-c model_reasoning_effort' for the worker (e.g. low, medium, high, xhigh, max, ultra). If unset, Codex uses its config.toml default.

tierModels.description: Override the tier→model map used for complexity-based dispatch. Values are provider/model strings; unset tiers fall back to built-in defaults.

branchTemplate.description: Template for the dispatch git branch name. Placeholders: {identifier}, {slug} (Title-Case issue title), {title}. Default: codex/{identifier}

repoSelectionMode.description: When to interactively ask the user which repo(s) to work on: off (never), ambiguous (only when no repo is specified and multiple are configured), always. Default: off.

codexBin.description: Path to the Codex CLI binary used by codex_run diagnostics and tools

claudeBin.description: Path to the Claude CLI binary used by claude_run diagnostics and tools

geminiBin.description: Path to the Gemini CLI binary used by gemini_run diagnostics and tools

enableOrchestration.description: Allow agents to spawn sub-agents via spawn_agent/ask_agent tools

worktreeBaseDir.description: Base directory for persistent git worktrees (default: ~/.openclaw/worktrees)

repos.description: Optional repository overrides. In github-app mode the live installation catalog supplies entries automatically; paths are only needed in legacy local mode.

path.description: Absolute filesystem path to git repo (legacy local mode)

defaultBranch.description: Default branch from the GitHub installation catalog

teamMappings.description: Map Linear team keys to repos, agents, and team-specific context

repos.description: Repo names (keys in 'repos' config) for this team

defaultAgent.description: OpenClaw agent ID to handle issues from this team

context.description: Extra context injected into worker/audit prompts for this team

dispatchStatePath.description: Path to dispatch state JSON file (default: ~/.openclaw/linear-dispatch-state.json)

planningStatePath.description: Path to planning state JSON file (default: ~/.openclaw/linear-planning-state.json)

notifications.description: Dispatch lifecycle notification config — fan-out to any combination of channels

targets.description: Notification targets — each routes to an OpenClaw channel

channel.description: OpenClaw channel name: discord, slack, telegram, signal, etc.

accountId.description: Account ID for multi-account channel setups (optional)

events.description: Per-event-type toggles (all default true, set false to suppress)

richFormat.description: Send rich embeds (Discord) and HTML (Telegram) instead of plain text

promptsPath.description: Override path for prompts.yaml (default: ships with plugin)

inactivitySec.description: Kill sessions with no I/O for this many seconds (default: 120)

maxTotalSec.description: Max total runtime for agent sessions in seconds (default: 7200)

toolTimeoutSec.description: Max runtime for a single code_run CLI invocation in seconds (default: 600)

claudeApiKey.description: Anthropic API key for Claude CLI backend (passed as ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env var)

enableGuidance.description: Inject Linear workspace/team guidance into agent prompts (default: true)

teamGuidanceOverrides.description: Per-team guidance toggle. Key = Linear team ID, value = boolean. Unset teams inherit enableGuidance.

enableTmux.description: Enable tmux wrapping for code_run CLI backends (enables steering)

retroDir.description: Override path for coding retrospective files (default: {stateDir}/shared/coding)
